_comment: Provider registry for operator mode. Any OpenAI-COMPATIBLE endpoint works with runner/relay.py unchanged. NEVER put a key in this file - keys live in secrets/<provider>.key (gitignored) or the named env var.

nvidia.notes: Free tier. Quota = HTTP 429; throttle below your quota or the run degrades silently. The arm used by the World-1 head-to-head per RESULTS.md.

openrouter.notes: One key, many models. Free tier is rate-limited; record model id exactly - aliases move.

groq.notes: Free tier, very fast, small context on some models.

gemini.notes: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The NATIVE API is not compatible - use this base_url or write an adapter.

anthropic.notes: OpenAI-compatibility is partial. Verify tool-calling behaves before trusting a run.

ollama.notes: Local, unlimited floor. Not comparable to a hosted arm unless BOTH arms use it - see the parity invariant.
